planned_workflow.dispatch_transport: Existing native gh authentication; currently exposed GitHub connector has no workflow-dispatch operation.

expected_release_flow: Bump Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock together on main
Create immutable v0.10.12 tag and dispatch release.yml for that exact tag
Run six-platform build and reusable CI checks
Verify both installed Linux server runtimes
Finalize manifests, checksums and workspace source packages
Publish GitHub release and crates as distinct jobs
Invoke deploy-server.yml with validated tag and source commit
post_deploy_verification: Official deployment receipt: completed, version, commit, running_sha256 equals target_sha256
Published immutable manifest and archive identity
Independent running server executable version and SHA-256
Direct and public health plus fingerprinted portal asset SHA-256, size and MIME
No secrets, authorization codes or private server addresses in public report
